selection: Explicit resident/citizen/inhabitant/colonist/passenger/settler/population wording, conservatively excluding specialist, household and single-person wording. This is a counting check, not a lore-verification classifier.
limitation: The remaining records include many valid societies as well as deliberately narrow institutions, households and person proxies. Failure of the counting rule is not a rejection. Every record still carries its actual population and assumptions.
